status_label: EXPLORATORY_ANALYSIS_OF_FIXED_PILOT (post hoc: written after P2-PILOT1 results were seen; same data, split, binning, predictors, mask rules, evaluator q and Gamma grid; not a confirmatory experiment)

parts.D_endpoint: For FR2 E0 truth, settings B and D, every Gamma_cc in the FR2 grid: max eta s.t. all definition-required rho >= eta and objective == reported endpoint (B: rho_full; D: rho_full and every incomplete stratum with a given conditional law).
parts.provenance: raw line -> parsed row -> dedup group (attribute tuple excl. fnlwgt, incl. raw income string) -> hash split; counts only, no preprocessing change.
parts.frozen_predictors: PILOT1 did not persist the predictor tables; they are re-derived deterministically from the same code, config and data and accepted only if PILOT1's recorded held-out Delta and complete-case dropout contrast are reproduced exactly (Fraction equality); the tables are then saved.
parts.expected_mask_law: p_bar(c,r) = (1/n) sum_i 1{C_i=c} pi_r(C_i) on the eval records, exact rationals, for primary_mnar and control_mcar; no new masks are drawn.
parts.comparison: A: expected-joint true Delta; B: expected complete-case dropout contrast; C: setting-C identified intervals from the expected observable laws only (Gamma grid of PILOT1); D: PILOT1 realised values (raw, unchanged).
parts.schema_check: setting-C intervals recomputed from a blinded Truth whose hidden joint mass and full-data law are replaced by uniform placeholders must be identical.
